decisions.reason: The sourcing exception does not change the selected AXP2101 component or any functional power-management constraint.
The source does not change the required current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of a separate INA device.
No backlight component, topology, supply, or population rule is changed by the general sourcing exception.
Allowing specialized components when sourcing requires them does not alter the single-board architecture, functional consolidation, or functionality-preservation requirements.
The source concerns integrated-board sourcing cost and does not modify the existing power-board AXP2101 topology or thermal requirements.
The SMD and through-hole price comparison does not change the required through-hole breakout, full pin access, or optional header assembly state.
The source does not identify or change the LED supply, switching, or data-level topology.
The general specialized-component exception does not remove or otherwise change the local decoupling requirement.
The source does not change panel-control coverage, GPIO mappings, connector usage, or component values.
No battery-protection mode or cutoff behavior is changed by the integrated-board sourcing exception.
The source does not identify or change the charge-status connector, LED arrangement, resistor values, or population rules.
The sourcing exception and component price comparison do not alter the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, or connector layout.
